description: This file is a shell script designed to test and compare different grep engines within git-log, particularly focusing on the --grep regex engine options in various configurations. It sets up environment variables, sources a library script, runs performance tests with different patterns and engines, and verifies consistency across the engines.

methods.name: test_perf_large_repo
methods.description: Sets up a large repository for performance testing.

methods.name: test_checkout_worktree
methods.description: Checks out the working tree for testing.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks for the presence of required prerequisites like PCRE.

methods.name: test_perf
methods.description: Runs performance tests with specified engines and options.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Verifies that commands produce expected output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output files to verify they are identical.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the completion of the test script.
